raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "intelhex" %}
{% set version = "2.3.0" %}
{% set sha256 = "892b7361a719f4945237da8ccf754e9513db32f5628852785aea108dcd250093" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  fn: {{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: {{ sha256 }}

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}

test:
  imports:
    - intelhex
  commands:
    - pip check
    # Double check that intelhex is included in the pip list
    - pip list
  requires:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}

about:
  home: https://pypi.python.org/pypi/IntelHex
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Python library for Intel HEX files manipulations
  doc_url: http://python-intelhex.readthedocs.org/en/latest
  dev_url: https://github.com/bialix/intelhex

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - windelbouwman
    - abloemert
    - avrahamshukron
